title: Bluesky's New AI App: Attie
full_monologue: **Bluesky is embracing AI with a new app called Attie.** Attie lets you build custom feeds using AI, making it easier than ever to curate your own content. Think of it as a smart filter that learns your preferences and tailors your experience. With Attie, you’re not just scrolling—you’re engaging with content that matters to you. Want to see how it works? Well, I can’t show you the app, but I can tell you this: it’s a game-changer. What do you think about AI-powered feeds?
